prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a colossal worm of overlapping dark purple armour plates with pale lilac-grey rings between them and dark outlines, reared up in an S from a heavy coil on the ground, the top end a round open maw lined with many rows of white teeth, the tail tip ending in a curved black stinger resting on the ground beside the coil; in every cell the raised front end stays well below the top of the grey box and the whole worm, stinger included, sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: no eyes; the round maw with rows of teeth is the readable feature.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, the front end arched forward and down toward the heroes with the toothed maw gaping, the coil and the stinger in place on the ground, the maw well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, the front end recoiling back and up, the maw clenched shut, the coil tightening, the stinger in place, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Coil and uncoil along a strong curve, strike the head toward the heroes with the front end bent so the maw stays well inside its own cell, and keep the stinger tail tip on the ground beside the coils. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, coiled upright inside the box, the lowest coil resting on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, eyes, a face, legs, pink skin, ochre colour, lava, sand, bright violet, magenta, a raised stinger.
